rationale.agent-scope-drift: Agents autonomously choose architectures beyond explicit prompts and recorded team intent.
rationale.oversight-scaling-inversion: Agent decisions take seconds while architectural review requires hours or days.
rationale.quality-debt: Prompt changes multiply components, dependencies, failure modes, and hidden architectural debt.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Conformance layer checks dependency graphs against declared constraints and flags violations.
rationale.risk-routing: Complexity thresholds trigger architectural review for unusually large generated changes.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Impact statements and extracted ADRs expose choices, rationale, risks, and consequences.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Persistent ADRs record agent-made architectural decisions for later human audit.
rationale.framework: Three-layer constraints-conformance-knowledge architecture is proposed for development pipelines.
rationale.design-only: Governance framework is specified but neither implemented nor empirically validated.
rationale.agentic: Study centers agents scaffolding complete projects and multi-step system architectures.
rationale.steering: Prompt specifications, instruction files, and architectural context substantively shape generation.
rationale.risk-quality: Paper analyzes complexity, coupling, maintainability, and technical-debt consequences.
rationale.method-experiment: Controlled prompt variants isolate architectural divergence in a third-party coding agent.
